cards.design_en: The focus is a petrol velvet crossed-neck top above a narrow mineral-jacquard midi skirt. A cropped espresso short-pile jacket stops at the natural waist. One amber-toned brooch closes the outer layer off centre; oxblood square-toe boots keep the hem grounded. The print is an original irregular mineral study, never a recognisable house motif.

legacy_reading_v4.body_en:
You would not wear this coat if you wanted to slip into a room unnoticed. It is big, soft and quite possibly patterned like a leopard. Add gold earrings and a pair of dark glasses, and the message is clear: somebody has arrived.

The internet calls this look “mob wife”. The name bundles together screen characters, Italian glamour and a taste for conspicuous dressing. It is a catchy label, although a poor description of real Italian-American women, whose lives and wardrobes are rather more varied. The clothes themselves are more interesting than the stereotype.

Take the coat. Its generous size makes the wearer look larger, but the soft pile keeps it from looking like armour. Underneath, a simple dress creates a sharp contrast. There is a useful lesson here: excess works best when something else stays quiet. Leopard print, sparkling jewellery and glossy leather do not all need equal billing.

Nor does confidence have to come in black and gold. A pomegranate-red dress under a pale wrap can make just as strong an entrance. The appeal of this wardrobe is permission to enjoy being visible. That is a more useful idea to take away than dressing as somebody’s wife.
legacy_reading_v4.body_zh:
如果你想悄悄走进房间，大概不会选这件外套。它宽大、柔软，可能还满是豹纹。再配金色耳环和墨镜，意思很明白：有人登场了。

网络把这种穿法叫作“mob wife”。这个顺口的标签把影视角色、意式华丽和张扬穿衣揉在一起，却很难描述真实的意裔美国女性——她们的生活和衣橱远比标签丰富。衣服本身比刻板印象更值得看。

就说外套。宽大的体积让人物显得更有分量，柔软绒毛又避免它像盔甲。里面一条简单裙子，便能形成鲜明对照。这里有个实用道理：某处尽情铺张，另一处最好安静下来。豹纹、闪亮珠宝和光亮皮革不必都当主角。

自信也不必只穿黑金。石榴红裙搭浅色披肩，一样能有出场感。这种衣橱最吸引人的，是允许自己享受被看见；比起扮演“谁的妻子”，这更值得带走。

legacy_questions_v4.prompt_en: Why does the writer put a simple dress beneath the large coat?
options_en: Its quiet surface lets the coat remain the main attraction.
It makes the whole outfit look less visible.
It connects the look to a particular screen character.
legacy_questions_v4.evidence_en: “Excess works best when something else stays quiet.”

legacy_questions_v4.prompt_en: Which would you remove from a leopard coat, sparkling necklace and glossy skirt combination? Explain what you would keep as the main attraction.

reading.title_zh: 张扬穿衣，是对安静奢华的反击吗？

source.title: Will the Mob Wife Aesthetic Take a Sledgehammer to Quiet Luxury?
source.author: Véronique Hyland
source.verification: 正文已通过公开网页读取
source.access_note: 核验时可读取正文；外站访问条件可能变化。
source.quote_en: The hallmark of mob wife style is excess
source.quote_zh: Mob Wife 风格的标志是铺张。

reading.guide_en: Hyland reads mob-wife style as a reaction against restrained dressing. Fur, big hair and animal prints make excess its signature. Her column connects a viral look with screen characters and the wider cycle of feminine fashion archetypes.
reading.guide_zh: 作者把这股张扬潮流放在克制穿衣的对面，联系影视角色与女性时尚形象。
reading.focus_zh: 看作者如何从衣服谈到文化，而非只列必买单品。

questions.prompt_en: What defines the style in this guide?
questions.explanation_zh: 导读把 excess 作为这股风格的辨识点。

questions.prompt_en: In this reading, what does “restrained” mean?
questions.explanation_zh: 结合导读语境，restrained 在这里表示：understated and controlled。

questions.prompt_en: Which detail would you choose to make a quiet outfit more conspicuous, and why?
questions.rubric_zh: 没有唯一答案。用一个具体服装、材料或视觉细节支持你的判断。

paragraphs.en: ELLE’s Véronique Hyland connects mob-wife dressing with screen archetypes and the rejection of quiet luxury. Her examples favour conspicuous glamour, large hair and animal patterns. This is a commentary on a circulating fashion image, rather than a description of every woman in a particular community.
paragraphs.zh: ELLE 作者把这股穿衣风格联系到影视形象与对安静奢华的反应。文章讨论的是流行的时尚形象，并不能用来描述某个群体中的所有女性。

paragraphs.en: Imagine a styling table with a soft coat, straight trousers and a small bag. First, look at the silhouette: is most of the volume around the shoulders, or does it continue through the legs? Then compare texture. The coat looks soft; the trousers look dry and smooth. That contrast gives each material room to be noticed.
paragraphs.zh: 想象桌上放着绒毛外套、直筒裤和小包。先观察体积集中在哪里，再看质感的对比：柔软绒毛与干爽平滑的裤料，会让两种材料都更容易被看见。

paragraphs.en: Now add one conspicuous accent. A small bright bag may do more than three large necklaces. If the coat already suggests excess, try a restrained top underneath. This is a styling exercise, not a rule about how confident people must dress. You can remove the accent, change the proportions, or keep the whole look quiet. Notice which decision changes the outfit most.
paragraphs.zh: 再加一个显眼的重点。小小的亮色包可能比三条大项链更有效。外套已经很张扬时，内搭可以克制一些。这只是搭配练习，并不是关于自信必须如何穿衣的规定。

vocabulary_cards.definition: more of something than is needed or usual

examples.en: The stylist used excess to make the simple entrance feel theatrical.
examples.zh: 造型师用铺张的细节，让普通的入场显得像戏剧。

examples.en: An excess of jewellery distracted from the shape of the coat.
examples.zh: 过多珠宝分散了人们对外套轮廓的注意。

vocabulary_cards.definition: controlled and not showing too much decoration or emotion

examples.en: Her restrained styling left the embroidered collar as the only decoration.
examples.zh: 她的搭配很克制，只有绣花领口作为装饰。

examples.en: A restrained palette helped the large coat remain the focus.
examples.zh: 克制的配色让大外套保持视觉重点。

vocabulary_cards.definition: easy to notice because it stands out

examples.en: The red bag was conspicuous against the plain grey suit.
examples.zh: 红色包在普通的灰色套装上非常显眼。

examples.en: She wanted one conspicuous detail that could be seen across the room.
examples.zh: 她想要一个在房间另一头也能看见的显眼细节。

vocabulary_cards.definition: the overall outline or shape of a person or garment

examples.en: The padded shoulders created a broad silhouette.
examples.zh: 垫肩制造出宽阔的轮廓。

examples.en: A belt can change the silhouette without changing the fabric.
examples.zh: 不改变面料，一条腰带也能改变廓形。

vocabulary_cards.definition: the way a surface looks or feels

examples.en: The soft texture of the coat contrasted with the smooth trousers.
examples.zh: 外套柔软的质感与平滑的裤子形成对比。

examples.en: The photograph showed texture clearly enough to suggest how the cloth might feel.
examples.zh: 照片清楚地呈现肌理，让人仿佛能感受到布料的触感。

vocabulary_cards.definition: a noticeable difference between things placed together

examples.en: The fluffy coat and narrow trousers created a sharp contrast.
examples.zh: 毛绒外套与窄腿裤形成鲜明对比。

examples.en: There was little contrast between the two almost identical fabrics.
examples.zh: 两块几乎相同的布料之间没有多少反差。

brand_studies.name: Roberto Cavalli

reference.credit: Roberto Cavalli · official runway gallery · Look 40
reference.observed_en: Crushed velvet, a liquid neckline and a long uninterrupted line.
reference.observed_zh: 压褶丝绒、流动领口与连续长线。

brand_studies.analysis_en: Compare a dominant print with a fluid cut. Reduce the printed area when the aim is to make material and drape readable, rather than to turn a motif into an entire identity.
brand_studies.analysis_zh: 保留 V4 的观察方法：比较主导印花与流动剪裁。需要看清材质和垂坠时，可以缩小纹样面积，而非把一个图案当成整套身份。
brand_studies.intro_en: For this lesson, the useful reference is Cavalli’s Fall/Winter 2024 runway. Watch the surface of velvet and the long dress line. Our interpretation replaces recognisable motifs with an original mineral pattern and uses a single metal accent.
brand_studies.intro_zh: 本关从 Cavalli 2024 秋冬的丝绒表面和长裙线条入手。原创转化采用自绘矿物纹样与单个金属重点，不复制品牌纹样。

brand_studies.name: Dries Van Noten

reference.credit: Dries Van Noten · official runway image · Look 7
reference.observed_en: A large tailored upper layer meets a soft pink textured skirt; material weight creates the contrast.
reference.observed_zh: 宽大的剪裁外层与粉色绒感半裙相遇，反差来自材料重量。

brand_studies.analysis_en: Study how tailoring, a soft surface and an unexpected colour can share an outfit without receiving equal visual weight.
brand_studies.analysis_zh: 研究剪裁、柔软表面与意外色彩如何共同出现，同时保留不同的视觉分量。
brand_studies.intro_en: The reference image pairs a generous tailored layer with pink texture. It suggests a useful question: can authority come from soft material and an unusual proportion? Our answer separates the three designs into a narrow skirt, a long dress and wide cropped trousers.
brand_studies.intro_zh: 参考图将宽大剪裁层与粉色绒感并置：气场能否来自柔软材料和意外比例？本组因此分别采用窄裙、长裙与宽阔短裤，形成三种结构。

references.credit: Roberto Cavalli · official runway gallery · Look 40
references.observed_en: Crushed velvet, a liquid neckline and a long uninterrupted line.
references.observed_zh: 压褶丝绒、流动领口与连续长线。

references.observed_zh: 宽大的剪裁外层与粉色绒感半裙相遇，反差来自材料重量。

brand_comparisons.name: Saint Laurent
brand_comparisons.analysis_en: Use narrow tailoring and long lines as one reference, not as the sole origin of a varied music and nightlife scene.
brand_comparisons.analysis_zh: 沿用 V4 的提问方式：把窄肩和长线当作一条参考，而不把一个品牌当成音乐与夜生活穿衣的唯一源头。

brand_comparisons.name: Miu Miu
brand_comparisons.analysis_en: Study how ordinary jersey, rib knit and coloured hosiery can control an outfit; distinguish a styled image from a wearer’s choices.
brand_comparisons.analysis_zh: 保留 V4 对日常基础衣的解读：针织、罗纹与彩色袜也能决定比例，并区分造型图像和穿着者自己的选择。

cards.silhouette_zh: 长格纹针织／直亮片中裙；松长上层压住窄亮下层

cards.design_en: A dusty-plum checked mohair cardigan falls past the hip over a washed charcoal scoop-neck T-shirt. A dull citron sequined straight midi skirt supplies the only reflective field. Worn lace-up ankle boots and a thin pewter chain keep the look off duty. The skirt stops below the knee, avoiding another jeans-and-jacket formula.

Oxblood loafers and plain ankle socks replace the predictable boot-and-denim ending.

legacy_reading_v4.title_en: The Clothes You Stayed Out In
legacy_reading_v4.body_en:
In a flash photograph, a sequined skirt and a cheap T-shirt can look perfectly at home together. The skirt catches the light. The T-shirt has seen better days. Neither seems especially interested in matching the other.

That uneasy mixture is a good place to start with indie sleaze. The label looks back at a world of gigs, clubs, music blogs and party photographs. Like many retrospective names, it makes the past look tidier than it probably felt at the time. There was no single outfit everyone agreed to wear.

What holds the look together is often an interruption. A narrow blazer meets battered jeans. A bright pair of tights breaks up an otherwise dark outfit. A glittering vest goes over ordinary cotton rather than directly onto bare skin. Something always prevents the clothes from becoming too polished.

This is where a modern version can go wrong. Buy every piece new, distress it neatly and coordinate all the accessories, and the result starts to look like fancy dress. A little awkwardness does useful work. The scarf can be too long; the bag can be practical rather than beautiful. These clothes suggest an evening that might go somewhere unexpected, not a photograph planned down to the last safety pin.
legacy_reading_v4.body_zh:
直闪照片里，亮片裙和便宜T恤可以相处得很好。裙子接住光，T恤明显旧了，两件衣服似乎都不怎么在意要与对方配套。

这种有点别扭的混合，是理解 indie sleaze 的好入口。这个标签回望演出、夜店、音乐博客与派对照片构成的世界。许多事后命名都会把过去整理得比亲历时更清楚，它也不例外；当时并没有大家约好穿的唯一制服。

让造型成立的，往往是一处打断：窄西装遇上破旧牛仔，鲜色袜子切开暗色搭配，闪亮马甲罩在普通棉T恤外，而不是直接贴着皮肤。总有什么阻止衣服变得过分完美。

现代演绎容易在这里走偏：全买新衣服，整整齐齐地做旧，再把配件全部配好，便开始像主题装扮。一点不协调很有用——围巾可以太长，包可以实用多于好看。它们让人想到一个可能临时转场的夜晚，而非连最后一枚别针都事先安排好的照片。

reading.title_zh: Indie Sleaze：复兴还能保留随意感吗？

source.title: Can We Ever Really Have an Indie-Sleaze Revival? Vogue Fashion Writers Debate
source.author: Christian Allaire; Hannah Jackson
source.verification: 正文已通过公开网页读取
source.access_note: 核验时可读取正文；外站访问条件可能变化。
source.quote_zh: 精心经营的形象成了一切。

reading.guide_en: Two Vogue writers debate an indie-sleaze revival. Allaire remembers improvised clothes and messy styling; he questions whether that spontaneity can survive today’s carefully curated images. The issue is authenticity, rather than simply bringing skinny jeans back.
reading.guide_zh: 两位编辑讨论：当形象经过精心经营，旧日穿搭的随意还能回来吗？
reading.focus_zh: 这是两位作者的讨论，不是全行业对复兴的共识。

questions.prompt_en: What tension does the guide identify?
questions.explanation_zh: 导读对比自发搭配与精心经营的形象。

questions.prompt_en: In this reading, what does “curated” mean?
questions.explanation_zh: 结合导读语境，curated 在这里表示：carefully selected and arranged。

questions.prompt_en: Can a carefully planned outfit still feel spontaneous? Give one example.
questions.rubric_zh: 没有唯一答案。用一个具体服装、材料或视觉细节支持你的判断。

paragraphs.en: Vogue writers Christian Allaire and Hannah Jackson debate whether indie sleaze can return. They recall clothes assembled with little planning and ask what happens when contemporary images are carefully managed. Their conversation leaves room for different views on how a revival might feel.
paragraphs.zh: 两位 Vogue 作者讨论 Indie Sleaze 能否回归：当代形象经过细致经营，旧日随意拼搭的气质还能保留多少？这是对谈中的不同判断，而非定论。

paragraphs.en: For our own styling experiment, open a suitcase before a small concert. There is a worn jacket, a plain shirt, a skirt and one scarf. The challenge is to improvise without shopping. Try the scarf as a loose belt, then remove it. Which version seems like an authentic expression of the wearer, rather than a copy of a photograph?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的搭配实验从演出前的行李箱开始：旧夹克、普通上衣、裙子和围巾。试着不买新东西，即兴搭配。哪个版本更像穿着者自己的表达，而不是对照片的模仿？

paragraphs.en: A spontaneous choice does not have to be careless. Sleeves still need to move, and shoes still need to fit. Equally, a curated outfit does not have to look stiff. A revival becomes interesting when an old detail meets a present need. Keep the jacket because its softened surface feels good, not because a trend says the exact decade must return.
paragraphs.zh: 随性的选择不等于不顾舒适；精心安排的搭配也不必僵硬。让旧细节回应今天的需要，复兴才会变得有趣。保留夹克可以是因为穿旧的表面舒服，而不只是为了复刻某个年代。

legacy_reading_v4.body_en:
Football shirts are not designed to be discreet. Colours identify a team; numbers identify players; badges announce belonging. Even before anyone touches a ball, the shirt has plenty to say.

Put that shirt over a lace skirt and its surroundings change. The broad blocks of colour meet a fine pattern of threads and holes. One garment is meant to be read from a distance, the other rewards a closer look. The contrast is visual before it becomes an argument about sport and femininity.

“Blokette” is one name used for this meeting of football references and delicate details. It can be a useful description, provided the wearer is allowed to be a person rather than a punchline. There is no contradiction in following a team and liking ribbons. Nor should anybody need to pass a football quiz before wearing a shirt.

The interesting question is what happens below the hem. A long narrow skirt extends the body beneath a wide jersey. High-waisted trousers interrupt it. A short pleated skirt leaves another kind of gap above the socks. These changes matter more than finding three different shirt colours. Once you start looking at length and volume, the outfit offers rather more possibilities than “sporty but cute”.
legacy_reading_v4.body_zh:
球衣本来就不追求低调。颜色指向球队，号码指向球员，徽章宣告归属。还没碰到球，它已经说了不少话。

把它穿在蕾丝裙外，周围的关系就变了。大色块遇到细线与小孔组成的花纹，一件要让远处看清，另一件值得靠近细看。先有这种视觉对比，才有关于运动与女性气质的讨论。

“Blokette”是人们给足球语汇与精细装饰相遇取的名字之一。只要穿衣者仍被当作具体的人，而不是笑话，这个称呼就有用。支持球队与喜欢缎带并不矛盾，穿球衣前也不该被要求通过足球知识测试。

更有意思的问题在衣摆下面：窄长裙延伸宽球衣下方的线条，高腰裤将它截断，短褶裙又在袜子上方留出另一种间隔。这些变化比找三种不同球衣颜色更重要。开始看衣长和体积以后，一套搭配的可能性远比“运动又可爱”丰富。

reading.title_zh: 球衣与蕾丝：混搭不只关乎甜酷

source.title: What’s the deal with TikTok’s ‘blokette’ aesthetic?
source.author: Ella Katz
source.verification: 正文已通过公开网页读取
source.access_note: 核验时可读取正文；外站访问条件可能变化。
source.quote_en: But fashion isn’t just visual. It’s political.

reading.guide_en: Ella Katz describes blokette as a meeting of football jerseys and coquette details. Bold sports colours sit beside lace and ribbons. Her article then asks how this mixture challenges conventional gender categories, rather than treating the outfit as merely cute.
reading.guide_zh: 文章从球衣与蕾丝的反差出发，进一步讨论服装中的性别分类。
reading.focus_zh: 原文后半段有设计师访谈，值得接着读。

questions.prompt_en: What does Katz explore beyond appearance?
options_en: The technical design of sports fabrics
questions.explanation_zh: 导读最后一句指出文章进入性别分类的讨论。

questions.prompt_en: In this reading, what does “conventional” mean?
questions.explanation_zh: 结合导读语境，conventional 在这里表示：established or traditional。

questions.prompt_en: Choose two garments usually placed in different style categories. How could they work together?
questions.rubric_zh: 没有唯一答案。用一个具体服装、材料或视觉细节支持你的判断。

paragraphs.en: Ella Katz describes blokette through sportswear and coquette details, then questions its relationship with gender categories. Her argument is more critical than a simple celebration of mixing: combining familiar masculine and feminine symbols does not automatically challenge the categories themselves.
paragraphs.zh: Ella Katz 从运动装与甜美细节谈起，也质疑这种混搭是否真的改变了性别分类。把两组既有符号放在一起，并不自动意味着打破分类。

paragraphs.en: At our styling table, place a jersey beside a skirt with a lace edge. Add a ribbon, but do not attach it yet. To juxtapose these pieces is to make their differences visible: knitted sportswear next to an open decorative surface, a broad shape next to a narrow strip of fabric. The contrast can work without erasing either material.
paragraphs.zh: 在搭配桌上，把球衣放在蕾丝边裙子旁，再放一条还没系上的饰带。并置是让材料之间的区别被看见：针织运动装、镂空装饰表面、宽阔形状与细窄布条。

paragraphs.en: Try three arrangements. Tie the ribbon to a bag, move it to the waist, then leave it out. Watch whether the skirt keeps a fluid line when the wearer walks. Conventional categories can be a starting point for discussion, but an outfit cannot tell you somebody’s identity. Describe what the garments actually do: how they move, fit and relate to one another.
paragraphs.zh: 试试把饰带系到包上、移到腰间，再完全取下。观察走动时裙子是否保持流动的线条。传统分类可以成为讨论起点，却不能凭衣服推断一个人的身份；更有用的是描述衣物的活动、合身与相互关系。

questions.prompt_en: What does Katz explore beyond appearance?
options_en: The technical design of sports fabrics
questions.explanation_zh: 导读最后一句指出文章进入性别分类的讨论。

questions.prompt_en: In this reading, what does “conventional” mean?
questions.explanation_zh: 结合导读语境，conventional 在这里表示：established or traditional。

questions.prompt_en: Choose two garments usually placed in different style categories. How could they work together?
questions.rubric_zh: 没有唯一答案。用一个具体服装、材料或视觉细节支持你的判断。

vocabulary_cards.definition: a knitted sports shirt, often associated with a team

examples.en: She wore a football jersey over a narrow satin skirt.
examples.zh: 她把足球球衣穿在窄长缎面裙外。

examples.en: The loose jersey left enough room to move her arms freely.
examples.zh: 宽松球衣给手臂留下充分的活动空间。

vocabulary_cards.definition: a delicate fabric with an open decorative pattern

examples.en: A strip of lace softened the edge of the sporty top.
examples.zh: 一条蕾丝柔化了运动上衣的边缘。

examples.en: The delicate lace allowed the darker fabric beneath it to show through.
examples.zh: 透过细致的蕾丝，可以看见下面较深色的布料。

vocabulary_cards.definition: a narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decoration

examples.en: A narrow ribbon tied the colours of the shoes and shirt together.
examples.zh: 一条窄饰带将鞋与上衣的颜色联系起来。

examples.en: She moved the ribbon from her hair to the handle of her bag.
examples.zh: 她把饰带从头发移到了包柄上。

vocabulary_cards.definition: following established or traditional ways of doing things

examples.en: The stylist questioned conventional categories of formal and casual clothing.
examples.zh: 造型师质疑正式装与休闲装之间的惯常分类。

examples.en: A conventional outfit was useful for the ceremony, but not required afterwards.
examples.zh: 典礼时传统搭配很实用，但结束后并不一定要继续穿。

vocabulary_cards.definition: to place different things next to each other so their relationship is noticeable

examples.en: The editor chose to juxtapose a sports shirt with a delicate skirt.
examples.zh: 编辑选择把运动上衣与精致裙子并置。

examples.en: We can juxtapose rough and smooth surfaces without making either one disappear.
examples.zh: 粗糙和平滑的表面可以并置，同时保留各自特点。

vocabulary_cards.definition: able to move or change smoothly rather than stay rigid

examples.en: The skirt formed a fluid line when she walked.
examples.zh: 她走动时，裙子形成流动的线条。

examples.en: Their approach to styling was fluid rather than fixed by strict categories.
examples.zh: 他们的搭配方式灵活，并不被严格分类固定。

game_lesson.wardrobe_mapping: Existing visible wardrobe items inspired by the design; concept garments are not represented as finished artwork.

brand_studies.name: Wales Bonner

reference.credit: Wales Bonner · Marathon · photograph by Filippo Fior
reference.observed_en: Brown tailoring and radiant blue satin connect formal structure with sportswear finishes; handwork remains specific to its makers.
reference.observed_zh: 棕色剪裁与亮蓝缎面连接正式结构和运动收边；手工技艺仍应归于具体制作者。

brand_studies.analysis_en: Examine how materials, craft and specific cultural narratives complicate sportswear; do not reduce the reference to a retro shoe.
brand_studies.analysis_zh: 保留 V4 的重点：观察材料、工艺与具体文化叙事怎样让运动服更丰富，而不是只记住一双复古鞋。
brand_studies.intro_en: Marathon connects sportswear with tailoring, satin and named hand-making traditions. Our designs borrow a question about material contrast; they do not claim an artisan technique or reproduce collaborative footwear, stripes or crests.
brand_studies.intro_zh: Marathon 把运动服与剪裁、缎面及有具体来源的手工传统联系起来。本组借鉴材料对比的思路，不冒称工艺来源，也不用联名鞋、标志条纹或队徽。

brand_studies.name: Martine Rose

reference.credit: Martine Rose · official Spring/Summer 2024 runway · Look 3
reference.observed_en: Long outerwear, a mesh sports top and short lower layers create deliberately displaced proportions.
reference.observed_zh: 长外层、网眼运动上衣与短下装制造有意错位的比例。

brand_studies.analysis_en: Compare exaggerated proportions with everyday dressing; use that question to develop the relationship between a sports top and the lower silhouette.
brand_studies.analysis_zh: 保留 V4 的比例研究：夸张形状如何进入日常穿衣，运动上衣又怎样改变下半身的视觉关系。
brand_studies.intro_en: The selected runway image uses a long outer layer over much shorter pieces. We translate displaced proportion into three separate constructions: a narrow skirt, generous Bermudas and an asymmetric pleated skirt. No team or sponsor graphic is used.
brand_studies.intro_zh: 所选秀场图用长外层覆盖更短的内层。本组把错位比例转化为窄裙、宽百慕大裤和不对称褶裙三种结构，不使用队伍或赞助商图形。
